headline: Oil Prices Rise on Escalating Mideast Attacks in Strait of Hormuz
summary: Brent crude futures closed higher as rising attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz increased freight and maritime transport risks in the Middle East.
why: Geopolitical conflict and maritime shipping disruptions in major oil chokepoints directly drive risk premiums in energy commodity markets.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Increasing security risks and attacks on shipping lanes in the Strait of Hormuz push oil prices upward.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Rising attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz heightened supply and freight risks in the Middle East, boosting crude oil prices.
